processing: Read the NASA float32 TIFF whose elevations are kilometres relative to the 1737.4 km lunar sphere.
Crop source rows 2400:2880 and columns 3360:3840 (30E to 60E, 90S to 60S).
Multiply elevation values by 1000 to metres.
Write float32 GeoTIFF with 1895.2094015093426 metre pixels and IAU:30110 authority metadata.

source.description: NASA Scientific Visualization Studio CGI Moon Kit LOLA LDEM_16 displacement map, 16 pixels per degree
